note: Crimson Isle faction reputation, and the two minions gated behind it. Every other minion merchant sells to anyone; only the Mycelium and Red Sand lines check what you have earned, and they check it tier by tier rather than once at the door.
source: Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki (hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki), Mycelium Minion and Red Sand Minion upgrade tables, cross-read against the Factions page. The two ladders are identical, and tier XII sits exactly on the 12,000 cap.
note_on_membership: Reputation is the whole requirement — you do not have to be standing in the faction to craft. Since November 2024 the two are tracked independently and gaining one no longer costs you the other, so a profile can hold both and both are read.
